I didn't write Erwin's name. In the place of the names he erased, I wrote my mother's.
Elena. Archivist Elena.
…I'm just talking to myself. Wherever the Chronicle was cut, there's the faintest trace of violet. Our ink is black.
My mother's journal had a scribble like this. 'Mirrors lie. The scribe in the mirror lies more.' I wonder what it means.
The Chronicle mentions seven kings. But there are eight crowns drawn. One is shaped like lightning.
Captain Loran. If you need something, keep it short.
You're here, apprentice. Boots laced tight?
Guardian. …That title still sits strange. But you did it.
You're here. The roster is burned. Now you lot are my roster.
Maps are drawn with your feet. A map drawn at a desk gets people killed.
An expedition needs three things. Food, blades, and a reason to come back.
Ever been to the northern sea? Your lungs freeze with every breath.
The scar? A sandworm bit me in the desert. Looks good, doesn't it?
The Elder… no, don't talk to me about him. I'm still angry.
About the expedition
The Order's expedition only moves when the seals waver.
The last expedition was twenty years ago. I was the only one who came back.
So you make sure you come back alive. That's an order.
The awakened guardians
The rusted knight, the ice giant, the stonemason on the summit, the priest of the sun.
They were meant to guard the seals. But when the fire woke, they went mad.
Or… they'd been waiting for someone all along.
The frozen sea
Fight on the ice. Fall in the water and your armor drags you under.
Cornelia, captain of the ghost ship. A woman who sails the same voyage over and over.
What I told Kael
I told Kael the truth. That he wasn't abandoned — he saved me.
He laughed. 'I know. I knew all along. I just needed someone to blame.'
…For twenty years we'd both been sorry.
I never told him. Kael went on blaming me.
It's all right. You need someone to blame to make it through twenty years.
…Sometimes I wonder if I should have told him.
The expedition
The Corps is the loudest expedition I've ever seen.
I mean that kindly.
There are many sunken ruins in the warm southern seas. A fellow brushing away sand there picked up a strange sheet of music, they say. Only the title was left.
Ever climbed somewhere high in a storm? The wind carries paper to you. Mostly rubbish, but… mostly.
On one expedition I caught three evokers. All three carried bottles of violet ink. They only show up during raids.
Nice to meet you, adventurer! I'm Morris, the adventure guide. If you're new, ask me anything.
Money left in the bank isn't lost even if you fall. Remember that!
Buy land, and no one can mess with anything inside it.
Learn the merchants' names and trading gets a lot more fun. Hanna, Bram, Peter…
There are lots of monsters at night. Plenty of torches!
About Goldia
Goldia was founded by people fleeing the storms.
The town hall is near the pier, and the merchants gather around the square.
The castle area is protected, so you can't break anything there. But buy land and you can build as you please!
The people of the Order
The Order of the Embers is in the building at the end of the pier. The Elder, the Archivist, and the Captain.
Once you finish the Beginner Adventurer's Path, the Elder will want to see you.
Welcome! These vegetables were picked this morning. See, there's still dew on them?
Always plant seeds you bought at the shop. Seeds picked up in the fields don't grow well.
Rainy days are the best. No need to water the fields!
Buy a farm plot and let's farm together. It's nice to have neighbors.
The soil's warm these days. Even in winter. Strange, isn't it?
Farming talk
Wheat grows fast but sells cheap; pumpkins take long but sell high.
Take the farmer job and you get a beginner's plot for free. You should try it!
The warming soil
When I till the field, the soil is lukewarm. As if something is burning down below.
My grandmother used to say: when the earth grows warm, an old fire is waking.
Here to sell fish? A good heavy one gets a better price.
It's you. I've cast my net again. The sea is… honest again.
The sea is honest. It gives back as much as you wait.
If you catch a golden fish, bring it to me. That's good luck.
Mending nets is work too. My fingers never get a day's rest.
Fish are vanishing from the northern sea. Forty years at sea and I've never seen the like.
The sea froze? …I thought so. The fish knew first and fled.
The vanishing fish
First the northern cod dwindled, then the salmon, and now even the squid are gone.
Fish are the first to leave when the sea is sick. It means the sea is sick.
The ghost ship tale
There's a story going round among fishers. On misty nights a ship passes over the ice.
Its sails are torn but it sails against the wind. And the captain still calls her sailors' names.
Elric
I let Elric go. When I opened the lantern, the laughter drifted away toward the sea.
The lantern I kept lit for fifteen years is out now. Strange — my heart feels warm.
The lantern is still with me. At night I hear laughter inside it.
Someday I'll have to let him go. …When the day comes that I can't cast a net, we'll go together.
My brother Elric
Elric cast a net better than me. And he had a loud laugh.
When he boarded Captain Cornelia's ship he said, 'Brother, when I'm back I'll catch you a big one.'
Fishing in warm seas, sometimes you haul up paper soaked in salt. Usually I throw it away, but once it said 'the eighth ship.'
They say on thunderstorm nights the drowned shed strange scales. Still tingling, they say.
Come in. Hungry? It's written all over your face.
Don't skip meals. Adventuring needs a full stomach too.
I hear Lorenzo at the restaurant made a new dish again. You can smell it from here.
A bowl of warm soup will see you through most cold.
Cooking talk
Same ingredients, but roast them or boil them and the taste is completely different.
When you go on an expedition, bring plenty of cooked meat. Raw meat will upset your stomach.
What are you after? Blades or armor?
A good blade clings to your hand. A bad blade bites it.
Enhancing is luck. But luck comes to those who prepare.
Thirty years in front of the fire. That's why I have no eyebrows.
Rare gear? I only sell it to those who've joined the expedition. Those are the rules.
Talk of the forge
Iron doesn't lie. It gets as hard as you strike it.
A blade that broke while enhancing? Melt it down again. People are the same.
The rusted knight's crest
I saw that helmet crest too. It's the crest of the Flame Knights.
My grandfather's grandfather said he forged blades for that order. I thought it was a legend.
Ever heard of the temple above the sea? They say it stands where the storm never ends. With eight pillars, apparently.
Welcome, customer! We have everything except what we don't… I mean, we have it!
Customer, look at this torch. It burns a long time. Really.
Business is good lately. Everyone must be getting ready for an expedition.
I talk too much? Customer, a merchant who doesn't talk goes hungry!
Did you know you can open a personal shop? You can sell your goods to other people.
Rumors these days
I heard at the pier that the southern sky is red every night.
And someone else says you can hear stone being carved at the mountaintop monastery. Nobody lives there!
I'm Edmund, the land merchant. Which land have you come to see?
Land doesn't disappear. It's the safest kind of wealth.
Land inside the castle is protected. It costs a bit more, though.
Choosing your neighbors well is part of buying land.
About the castle area
The castle area is a protected zone managed by the Goldia town hall.
You can only build and break inside land you've bought. Everything outside belongs to everyone.
I'm Sera, the raid merchant. I exchange weekly raid rewards.
Raids are easier with others than alone. Form a party.
This week's boss is no pushover. Prepare well.
The flame of the raid
The Lord of Flame in the weekly raid… they say it's a shadow left by the First Flame.
It blazes up in the same form every week. Someone has to keep putting it to rest.
Welcome! I'm Lucy, the ticket seller! Buy today's luck!
